A world war paused Cardiff's reservoir 💧
Cardiff's Victorian water came from the Taff Fawr valley. Cantref Reservoir opened in 1892, holding 323 million gallons. Work on the bigger Llwyn-on Reservoir began in 1911, was suspended in 1915 because of the First World War, resumed in 1919 and opened in June 1926. It holds 1,260 million gallons, and Llwynon treatment works still supplies parts of Cardiff today.
